name: MidNightMonkeys.
summary: Be a monke. In MidNightMonkeys, you can chill with friends in a private lobby, or play around in the forest map, canyons map, mountains map, caves, or city! we also have a variety of cosmetics for normal players and some special ones for staff! All in all, have fun, be nice, and have a good time in MidNightMonkeys.
